arguments.question: For ANET, MU, META and NVDA over 21/63 sessions, use seeded SEC facts/submissions and primary company material where available to identify the latest reported revenue, earnings/cash-flow trend, company-specific demand/capacity/competitive catalysts and risks, and whether inputs support explicit bear/base/bull EPS×P/E scenario sensitivities. Treat QQQ only as a look-through exposure, not a corporate issuer. Stop after the latest material filing/report per issuer plus any clearly dated primary update; report missing valuation inputs explicitly.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether each company has a differentiated fundamental catalyst/risk and whether scenario valuation can be shown rather than relying on market momentum.
